prompt:
We've just built SchemaDrift, a developer tool for detecting unexpected PostgreSQL schema changes in production. We have zero community presence and need to start getting our name out there.

Someone on the team already ran some community research and saved the raw results under the `research/` folder. There's also a product brief at `docs/product-brief.md`.

Your job: Use all of that material to produce a complete community outreach plan saved as `outreach-plan.md` inside the `docs/` folder. The plan should cover which community threads are worth engaging with, include actual draft responses we can post (with appropriate transparency about who we are), and a launch checklist for ProductHunt. Make sure to apply judgment about which threads are actually worth our time — not all of the research findings are worth acting on.
